title: Albatross Ridge Vineyards Electric Bike Tour & Wine Tasting
requirements: Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
4-6ppl

Embark on a captivating electric bike tour through the breathtaking vineyards of Albatross Ridge, a truly exceptional winemaking destination, hidden amongst the hills of Carmel Valley and the Carmel Coast.

Upon arrival, your experience begins with a brief overview and training on the customized e-bike. Your guide will lead you throughout the undulating terrain to soak in the breathtaking vistas, and discover the profound stories woven into each vine and wine. 

After your electric bike excursion, a guided wine tasting and picnic lunch will be ready for your enjoyment. The Albatross Ridge team will continue to elevate your experience by teaching and conversing with you about each handcrafted estate wine on the very land it is grown, accompanied by an artisanal cheese and charcuterie board and local cuisine. Experience the culmination of passion, tradition, and organic farming principles, which combine to create the extraordinary wines that embody the essence of Albatross Ridge.
